logo.markAlt: Phoenix, the emblem of Andrea's Fashion Hair

hero.filmAlt: A silent film accompanies scrolling: embers rise in the dark, open into phoenix wings made of light and become real, honey-coloured hair on a pale head form. The camera comes to rest on the parting.

scene1.label: New beginning
scene1.title: Reborn.
scene1.body: Human hair, worked by hand, hair by hair. For the morning you recognise yourself in the mirror again.

scene2.label: Identity
scene2.title: It is not just hair.
scene2.body: It is who you are. Losing your hair means losing a piece of confidence. The phoenix in our emblem stands for the day it comes back.

scene3.label: Invisible
scene3.title: No one sees a transition.
scene3.body: Wafer-thin nano skin base, every hair injected individually, free parting. You barely feel your piece. Others do not see it at all.

home.fact1: Human hair. No synthetic hair, no blends.
home.fact2: Every piece is made individually and exists exactly once.
home.fact3: working days until an in-stock piece reaches you.
home.fact4: working days for a piece made to your measurements.
home.finderTitle: What are you missing right now?
home.finderLead: Tell us, and we will show you the pieces made for it.
home.finderEmpty: No piece is available here right now. Andrea will gladly make one to measure.
home.craftLead: An off-the-shelf topper sits on your head. Ours becomes part of it. The difference lies in four things.
home.craftImageAlt: Hands working individual hairs into a wafer-thin base
home.craft1: Nano skin, as thin as a second skin. It lies flat and disappears under your hairline.
home.craft2: Every single hair is injected by hand. So it seems to grow straight from the scalp.
home.craft3: Free in every direction. Wear it left, right or centre, however your day feels.
home.craft4: Clips that sit in seconds and come off just as quickly in the evening.
home.atelierLead: Each of these pieces exists only once. Once it is sold, it does not come back.
home.phoenixLead: At nineteen, Andrea began working with hair in Rio de Janeiro. Since then she has seen what happens to a person who loses their hair. And what happens when it comes back.
home.phoenixQuote: “When the hair is back, the person is different. They are reborn.”
home.phoenixOutro: That is why every piece from her atelier carries this emblem. It does not stand for hair. It stands for the morning after.
home.extLead: Human hair extensions in six methods, for clients and for salons. Andrea puts together colour, length and amount for you personally.
home.extImageAlt: Human hair extensions in three shades: weft, tape, bondings and clip-in
home.stepsLead: You only pay once Andrea has personally confirmed your piece.
home.step1: In the shop or together with Andrea. A photo in daylight is enough, and she will tell you honestly which colour suits you.
home.step2: She checks your piece by hand once more and writes to you. Only then do you pay.
home.step3: We send in-stock pieces with {carrier}. They usually reach you 2 to 5 working days after Andrea’s confirmation.
home.faqTitle: What you would like to know first.
home.faq1Q: Can people tell that I am wearing a hair piece?
home.faq1A: That is what the nano skin base is made for. Every hair is injected individually, so the parting looks like your own scalp. Even up close, no edge and no knot can be seen.
home.faq2Q: How do I know which colour suits me?
home.faq2A: Send Andrea a photo of your hair in daylight through the consultation form. She compares it with the pieces in the atelier and tells you openly which one suits you and which does not.
home.faq3A: With small clips on your own hair. It takes seconds, holds all day and needs neither glue nor a hairdresser's appointment.
home.faq4Q: How quickly will my piece reach me?
home.faq4A: In-stock pieces usually reach you 2 to 5 working days after Andrea’s confirmation, shipped with {carrier}. A made-to-measure piece needs 15 to 20 working days, because it is made for you first.
home.faq5Q: When and how do I pay?
home.faq5A: Not when you send your order. Andrea first confirms your piece personally and then tells you how to pay.
home.faq6Q: I cannot find my piece. Can it be made to measure?
home.faq6A: Yes. Length, colour, density and base are matched to you. Describe to Andrea what you would like, and she will get back to you with a proposal.
home.closeLead: Your piece may already be finished. Take a look before someone else wears it.
home.closeImageAlt: A woman in front of the atelier mirror, touching her hair

about.metaDescription: Andrea's Fashion Hair from Iserlohn, Germany: human hair toppers, wigs and hair systems, made with respect for the people who wear them.
about.title: Where technology meets humanity. Where beauty meets renewal.
about.p1: Andrea's Fashion Hair grew out of a passion for excellence and, above all, out of deep respect for people.
about.p2: We know that hair is far more than individual strands. It carries stories, memories, identity, femininity, personality and self-confidence. For many people it is a matter of course to recognise themselves in the mirror. For others, especially people with alopecia, scalp conditions, medical treatments or thinning hair, that look can become a challenge.
about.p3: We are here for these people.
about.p4: We create more than hair prostheses and toppers: we create ways to feel close to yourself again.
about.quote: “Hair is deeply personal. Every piece we craft is built to feel like yours from the first moment.”
about.v1: Hair technologies and premium materials that respect your identity and create a truly natural result.
about.v2: Every piece is designed for lightness, hold and well-being, and becomes part of your everyday life effortlessly and discreetly.
about.v3: We create more than hair solutions: we create the freedom to recognise yourself, to live fully and to show who you are.

objections.title: What you would like to know before buying
objections.visibleQ: Can people tell that I am wearing a hair piece?
objections.visibleA: That is what the nano skin base is made for: every hair is injected individually, so the parting looks like your own scalp.
objections.colorQ: Does the colour match my hair?
objections.colorA: Send Andrea a photo of your hair in daylight, most easily via WhatsApp. She compares it with the piece and tells you honestly whether it matches.
objections.holdClips: With small clips on your own hair. It takes seconds and needs neither glue nor a hairdresser’s appointment.
objections.holdOther: The attachment depends on the piece. Andrea will explain personally which method suits you.
objections.careQ: How do I care for the piece?
objections.careA: Andrea gives you the care instructions for your piece personally. Feel free to ask beforehand via WhatsApp, phone or enquiry.
objections.fitQ: Will it fit my head shape?

objections.fitNoBase: No base size is given for this piece. Andrea will gladly tell you whether it suits you.
objections.returnQ: What if it does not fit?
objections.returnA: You have a statutory right of withdrawal of 14 days from receipt of the goods. Details and exceptions are in the cancellation policy.
objections.payA: Not when you send the order. Andrea first confirms your piece personally and then tells you how to pay.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.lead: More length, more volume, more you. You can order the packs below directly. For other methods, lengths and amounts, Andrea puts everything together personally and gives you a fixed price.
extensions.butterflyText: A particularly fine, flexible weft that lies flat against the head.
extensions.geniusText: A thin weft that can be cut to the width you need.
extensions.invisibleText: Tape extensions with a particularly thin, inconspicuous tape.
extensions.tapeText: Strands with adhesive tape that are placed between your own hair.
extensions.keratinText: Individual strands attached to your own hair with a keratin bond.
extensions.clipText: Ready-made pieces you clip in yourself, without a salon visit. For example for more length if your hair is shoulder-length.
extensions.which: Andrea will gladly discuss with you which method suits your hair.
extensions.salonText: Would you like to source human hair extensions in quantity for your salon? Andrea will make you an individual offer.
extensions.otherText: If you do not find it here, Andrea will put it together for you on request. Salons and hairdressers also receive a personal offer.
